items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the unlabelled theorem at source lines 1611-1619, Theorem 6.11.6: F(A) is the free group on A, i.e. composition with eta is an equivalence from hom_Group(F(A),G) to A -> G for every group G. The statement is a universal property of a higher inductive type that is itself 0-truncated, and the proof (source lines 1620-1625) is short but not routine: the forward direction is exactly the recursion principle, whose data must include the multiplication, identity, inverse and the group axioms of the codomain (line 1621), and the computation rules are what simultaneously give fbar o eta := f and the statement that fbar is a homomorphism (line 1622). The left-inverse direction at line 1624 is again an induction over the same constructors rather than a computation.
